summary: New briefing covers a fix ensuring the three real Gap screenshots (921x2000 natural ratio) render fully uncropped via object-fit: contain / overflow: visible instead of being cropped. Added 1 new browser check covering all 4 acceptance criteria (visibility/no-clipping, containment CSS, balanced composition, responsive desktop+mobile) and re-ran 3 pre-existing browser checks (gap-flagship-entrance, reveal-grouped-sections-visible, mobile-and-reduced-motion-accessible) to confirm no regressions. All 4 checks passed. No backend/API surface backs this purely visual/CSS criterion set, consistent with prior iterations (static content-driven portfolio).
backend_note: No app-specific backend endpoints back any of the 4 new criteria; no backend test files were added.

checks.criterion: All three real Gap screenshots are fully visible with no vertical clipping / Gap screenshot containers use containment rather than cropping / composition remains balanced / responsive at desktop and 390x844
checks.name: gap-screenshots-aspect-ratio-contain
checks.evidence: At 1280x900 and 390x844: all 3 slots (gap-home-image-slot, gap-smart-recommendation-image-slot, gap-new-task-image-slot) visible, images loaded (naturalWidth/Height > 0), computed .iphone-image object-fit === 'contain', computed .iphone-frame overflow === 'visible' with no forced cropping aspect-ratio; rendered img boundingBox width/height ratio matched natural 921/2000 ratio within 5% tolerance at both viewports; center (Smart Recommendation) boundingBox height greater than both side screens confirming prominence/composition; document scrollWidth-clientWidth <= 2 at both viewports (no horizontal overflow); zero failed image requests.
